programs.overview: Curated to help schools align early with key BP, WSDC, and global speech tournaments. Enables informed tournament selection and structured preparation support.

programs.overview: Real-world, custom-sourced projects with top companies. Direct industry engagement through MOUs & company mentors. Interest-based matching with dual certification.
programs.date: Fixed Start Dates: May / June / July 2026

programs.title: GeniusHub Summer Cohort 2026
programs.overview: Build a strong portfolio with real-world projects. Gain hands-on experience through guided mentorship and showcase practical skills beyond academics.

programs.title: BuildUp Summer 2026 – June Cohort Updates
programs.overview: 50+ projects across industries including AI, healthcare, climate-tech, consulting, finance, sustainability, growth strategy, engineering, public policy, and more.

programs.organisation: Saïd Business School, University of Oxford

programs.overview: A 10-day NUS on-campus programme fostering entrepreneurial skills through business plan creation and idea pitching.

programs.overview: A 3-day online aviation internship. Interactive, career-focused program with research tasks, a certificate, and a chance to win a model aircraft.

programs.title: Ashoka Horizons Achievers Programme

programs.title: World Beyond Textbooks – Future Readiness Courses (Futurowise)
programs.overview: Top skills to explore: Cryptocurrency & Blockchain, Physical AI & Industrial Bots, Explorations in Design, Ocean and Space Exploration, Astronomy & Astrophysics, Carbon Credit Trading, and more.

programs.title: NextGen Labs: Learning Workshops by Masters' Union
programs.overview: Hands-on workshops in startups, app design, branding, stock investing, and AI — delivered by industry experts from the Masters' Union.

programs.overview: A skill development bootcamp where students learn future-ready skills like content creation, app building, and stock market fundamentals, and compete in Corporate MUN simulations.

programs.overview: Free coaching initiative by IIT covering entrance exams: JEE, NEET-UG, CUET-UG, and ICAR. Register online through the SATHEE platform.

programs.title: Penn STEP (Student Tutoring Empowerment Program)
programs.overview: Supercharge your high school GPA, earn a certificate from Thinkist, experience transformational leadership development, and excel in math and self-awareness skills.

programs.title: Australia Connect Program
programs.overview: For students aspiring to study in a bachelor's program and work in Australia. Free registration.

programs.title: Johns Hopkins University – Online Workshops
programs.overview: Virtual workshops offered by Johns Hopkins University. Register for upcoming workshops and more.
